backstory.v: Beifalla receives HyperNorm visitors with a fan held safely below the compliment. A card suggesting that generosity can leave its recipient free earns her most amused unequal glance: a favour is either appreciated or wasted. Hunky & Dory admire her influence. She turns the ring toward the light while waiting for gratitude to discover its own obligations.

frizzlebob.v: Die Einladung ist ausgesprochen. Die Gegenleistung darf sich noch überraschen lassen.

A card suggesting that legitimacy needs more than an impression earns his majestic lower lip: a matter is either sanctioned or improperly presented. Men in Black expect visible authority. He grips the handle with both hands and waits for the ceremony to lift its share.

frizzlebob.v: Die Würde hat Gewicht. Die Amtshandlung versucht es abzustellen.

He moves one bead back, hoping the direction of travel will clarify what has been gained.

frizzlebob.v: Die Rechnung geht auf. Ihr Bezug zur Sache wurde zurückgestellt.

He changes his grip and considers whether the corridor might respond better to being addressed as water.

She studies the recipient, wondering whether the seal protects the words or merely their owner.

frizzlebob.v: Die Nachricht bleibt verschlossen. Der Empfänger beginnt bereits mit der Auslegung.

backstory.v: Schlüsselzweifel waits at the HyperNorm side entrance with a key in one hand and his pendant under the other. A card suggesting that belonging can precede admission deepens his worried lower lip: a visitor is either recognised or outside. Men in Black demand careful access. He looks upward for the forgotten distinction between having the key and being entitled to turn it.

frizzlebob.v: Der Zugang ist geregelt. Der Berechtigte sucht noch nach seiner Eigenschaft.
